rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
F = qvB sinθ
ε = −N dΦ/dt
F = BIL

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Lorentz force" as one blob → ✅ split into: lorentz force, motion of charged particles in magnetic fields.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Force on moving charge F = q(v×B); on a wire F = BIL sinθ.  ·  Faraday: EMF ε = −dΦ/dt; Lenz's law gives the sign (induced current opposes the change in flux).
